deviations.what: Add task t14: fix the worker peer-resolution gap in lobes/gateway/server.py (add 'worker' to _PEER_SERVED_NAME_ENV and _PEER_ROLE_HINT) plus a regression test asserting every PEER_PROXY_ENV role resolves a served name. PR 1 becomes a CODE pr, delivered to the Spark via the documented TestPyPI dev lane (MODEL_GEAR_VERSION=0.54.8.devN + GATEWAY_PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL) rather than deployment-only.
deviations.reason: t1 (the falsification task) DISPROVED boundary claim c6. lobes/gateway/server.py's _PEER_SERVED_NAME_ENV and _PEER_ROLE_HINT still carry only the five pre-worker roles, while _config.py's PEER_PROXY_ENV carries eight. _peer_served_name therefore returns '' for worker even with WORKER_SERVED_NAME set, so peer_specs_from_table drops it at its 'if not served_name: continue' guard: no peer probe, no /v1/models entry, no _proxied_owner match. WORKER_PEER_PROXY=true would have been SILENTLY INERT. Verified independently against the real build_config/peer_specs_from_table/_peer_served_name (worker -> specs=[]; muse -> specs=['muse']), and the 2-line fix verified to resolve it via both the env-override and catalog-fallback paths. Consequently c17's 'PR 1 is deployment-only' is also false: the gateway pip-installs lobes-cli==MODEL_GEAR_VERSION, so the fix must be PUBLISHED before the box can use it.
